notes: Receiver minimum input power -20.0 dBm: receiver sensitivity at unamplified configurations (footnote 1). -12.0 dBm (footnote 2): signal power of the channel at the OSNR performance value. Input sensitivity -12.0 dBm (footnote 3): input power needed to achieve post FEC BER. OSNR tolerance max 26 dB/0.1 nm at CFEC threshold (footnote 4). Optical path OSNR penalty tolerance max 0.5 dB: OSNR tolerance penalty over OSNR tolerance due to reflections and dispersion (footnote 5). PMD tolerance min 10 ps with <0.5 dB penalty to OSNR sensitivity (footnote 6). Rx_LOS assert -28.0 dBm set to comply with 400G modes; can be changed on individual modules (footnote 7). Power consumption stated as < 20 W (Class 8). Nominal/transmit wavelengths 191.275–196.125 THz in 6.25 GHz steps; overview also states ITU C-Band 100 GHz grid (75 GHz grid optional). TECHNICAL DATA lists MSA compliance QSFP-DD MSA for an OSFP module. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Latency 8µs. Ordering/title: OSFP OIF 400G-ZR Ethernet Coh Tunable Flexgrid 120km LC D9128-D9612.
suggestions: No table cells use @ notation with paired penalized values; footnotes 5–6 describe penalties without a single penalized numeric OSNR/sensitivity at that penalty, so penalties array is empty per rules.
